children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) looks neutral in a range of $6.90 to $6.95-3/4 per bushel, and an escape could suggest a direction.
A break below $6.90 may open the way toward $6.83-3/4. However, the bias might be toward the upside, as the market not only stabilized around $6.90 but also bounced off this level.

The rising channel also remains intact. A break above $6.95-3/4 may lead to a gain into the $6.99-1/2 to $7.05-1/4 range. On the daily chart, the market has started a bounce around a key support at $6.68-1/2, the 61.8% retracement of the uptrend from $5.90 to $7.94-1/2.
The stabilization around this support, along with the current bounce, suggests a reversal of the downtrend from $7.94-1/2. Immediate target is $7.16-1/2.
